==Usage==
This can be used to cite information from the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2013)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' (2013)]]. Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number" with the appropriate information.
*<nowiki>{{</nowiki>FactFile2013|ISSUE NUMBER|PAGE RANGE|ENTRY}} (new way)

==Example==
====Code====
*<nowiki>{{FactFile2013|1|YAV 1-4|The Battle of Yavin}}</nowiki>
====Result====
*{{FactFile2013|1|YAV 1-4|The Battle of Yavin}}
